questions.question: The 'Simon Commission' (1927) was boycotted because:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is It had no Indian members.

  • The Simon Commission arrived in India in 1928.
  • It was boycotted because it had no Indian members (all seven members were British).
  • The slogan 'Simon Go Back' was coined during the protests.
  • Lala Lajpat Rai died from injuries sustained during an anti-Simon Commission protest.

questions.question: The 'Dandi March' (Salt Satyagraha) began from Sabarmati Ashram on March 12, 1930 and ended at Dandi on:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is April 6, 1930.

  • The Dandi March started on March 12, 1930 from Sabarmati Ashram.
  • Gandhi reached Dandi on April 5, 1930 and broke the salt law on April 6, 1930.
  • It marked the beginning of the Civil Disobedience Movement.
